sloka: ततस्तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं यशस्विनमरिन्दमम् ।आसीनं स्थण्डिले रामं ददर्श सहसा जन: ॥ २.१०२.४५॥
transliteration: tatastaṁ puruṣavyāghraṁ yaśasvinamarindamam ।āsīnaṁ sthaṇḍile rāmaṁ dadarśa sahasā jana: ॥ 2.102.45॥

translations.english: All at once the people saw the illustrious Rama, the best of men, and the subduer of enemies squatting on the bare earth.
